_comment: Statuses: live-per-site = on the live site AND backed by code; live = confirmed by Sumit; in-code = backend implements it, production not confirmed; not-live = Sumit says it is not available to users today; no-evidence = claimed on the site, no backend support found. Only live and live-per-site may be claimed in copy. Flip a status to 'live' to publish gated pages.

membership_lifecycle.evidence: members/*, renew, suspend, freeze, gift-days routes

invoices_renewals.evidence: invoice_views.py, members/<id>/renew | Play listing 'What's new' (Sep 28 2026) mentions editing an invoice's plan, dates and paid amount, and a custom date range on Finance.

dues_partial_payments.evidence: Owner: dues and partial payments work in production. | invoices/<id>/collect-payment, dues/today, dues/summary, dues/members

gst_tax_lines.evidence: Owner: GST/tax lines on invoices work in production. | GymTax, InvoiceTax models; tax_views.py; company_gst field (models.py:122). Not verified: CGST/SGST vs IGST split, GSTIN on invoice, HSN/SAC

qr_attendance.evidence: Owner: one QR per gym; first scan checks in, next scan checks out. | attendance/scan, owner/gym/<id>/attendance*, qr_views.py

biometric_adms.evidence: Owner: tested with a real device in production. | biometric_adms_views.py, biometric_owner_views.py. Mentioned in passing on /pricing and home FAQ; needs confirmation. Device models unknown.

workout_diet_plans.evidence: Plan builders exist in code, but Sumit says workout and diet plans are not available to users. Do not mention workout plans or diet plans. | The Play listing's feature list covers members, attendance, subscriptions and profile data only; it does not mention workout or diet plans.

plan_requests_approval.evidence: Depends on workout and diet plans, which are not live.

template_marketplace.evidence: Owner: template marketplace works in production. | WITHHELD FROM COPY: PlatformTemplate holds diet and workout plan templates, and the owner says diet and workout plans are not available. Do not mention the marketplace while diet_plans and workout_plans are N. | owner/templates/* routes

whatsapp_sms_push_alerts.evidence: auth_core/notifications/*; notify_* commands. Provider Fast2SMS WhatsApp: do not say 'WhatsApp Business API' until confirmed

notification_campaigns_wallet.evidence: Owner: campaigns and credit wallet work in production. | notification_campaign_views.py, notification_wallet_views.py

ecommerce_cart_orders.evidence: Owner: N. | cart_views.py, order_views.py, product_views.py exist, but Sumit says the store is not available to users. Do not mention online store, products, cart or orders. | The Play listing's feature list does not mention a store or orders.

multi_branch_franchise.evidence: Owner: multi-branch and franchise work in production. | owner/franchise, owner/gyms, multi_branch_analytics_views.py

branded_android_member_app.evidence: dashboard_views.py, whitelabel_views.py. How per-gym branding works in the app is unverified

white_label.evidence: Owner: white-label works in production. | owner/whitelabel (OwnerWhitelabelView) | Play listing 'What's new' (Sep 28 2026) says 'Faster app startup for branded gyms', which suggests branded builds exist. Not confirmed live.

public_gym_profile_api.evidence: PublicGymProfileView (JSON only, marketing_views.py). No consent flag or HTML pages yet

self_serve_signup_subscription.evidence: Owner: N. Keep pricing as custom quote and demo CTA; never say owners can sign up and pay by themselves. | auth/org/register, owner/plans, owner/subscribe. Site says 'we build your account' and 'custom quote'

class_scheduling_booking.evidence: No booking/enrolment routes. Only batches + opening hours

staff_salary_attendance_hr.evidence: No staff attendance or salary models

gym_faqs_text_video.evidence: FAQ model is platform-level, super-admin only

report_export_excel_pdf.evidence: No export endpoints found; dashboard may export client-side. Ask Sumit

due_payment_reminders.evidence: Owner: N. | Owner (Sumit), 2026-10-11: not scheduled yet; will say when it changes. notify_due_payments command exists, but the job is not scheduled in production (25 Sep audit). NO page may claim automated due-payment reminders.

whatsapp_expiry_reminders.evidence: Owner: cron scheduled and delivering. | send_membership_alerts: WhatsApp 7, 3 and 1 days before expiry plus the day after, to members. Live only after Sumit confirms the schedule is running.

whatsapp_birthday_messages.evidence: Owner: birthday messages work in production. | notify_member_birthdays. Live only after Sumit confirms the schedule is running.

play_store_listing.evidence: Chrome in this run: https://app.fitvario.com 301-redirects to https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fitvario.sumigyan. The listing loads with an Install button, 'Fitvario – Gym Management App', last updated Sep 28, 2026. Open question: the listing text is aimed at gym owners and trainers, so confirm whether this single app is also the member app.

owner_web_dashboard.evidence: Owner (Sumit), 2026-10-11: there is no owner web dashboard; owners use the mobile app. Site copy must not mention a web dashboard, web panel or staff portal.

diet_plans.evidence: Owner: N. | Split out of workout_diet_plans so each can be answered alone. Owner said diet plans are not available. diet_owner_views.py, diet_member_views.py: templates, per-member assignment, day-by-day completion, restart, member requests.

workout_plans.evidence: Owner: N. | Split out of workout_diet_plans. Owner said workout plans are not available. workout_owner_views.py, workout_member_views.py: templates, per-member assignment, exercise completion, restart, member requests.

expense_manager.evidence: expense_views.py ExpenseListCreateView/ExpenseDetailView: dated expenses with line items per gym. The older revenue_expense_analytics flag lumps this with analytics; answer this one for the expense screens themselves.

recurring_expenses.evidence: RecurringExpense + RecurringExpensePauseView; management command process_recurring_expenses creates the entries. Cron schedule not verified.

customer_categories.evidence: customer-categories routes and CustomerCategory model: owner-defined member groups per gym.

gym_gallery_highlights.evidence: marketing_views.py Gallery and Highlight views (owner/gym/gallery, highlights); plan-gated by the 'gallery' feature.

gym_hours_and_closures.evidence: schedule_views.py: weekly schedule with slots, temporary closures, open-status (also public). GymSchedule, GymScheduleSlot, GymTemporaryClosure.

platform_banners.evidence: banner_views.py OwnerBannerListView / MemberBannerListView: banners set by the platform admin, shown in the apps.

owner_referral_program.evidence: Owner: owner referral works in production. | GymOwnerReferral, GymOwnerCoinWallet; owner/referral, owner/coin-wallet, owner/apply-coins: owners refer owners and earn coins.

subscription_coupons.evidence: PlatformCoupon; owner/apply-coupon on the Fitvario subscription. Internal pricing tool, rarely a marketing claim.

platform_store_for_owners.evidence: platform_store_views.py, owner/store, gym/store: PlatformProduct, PlatformOrder, PlatformInvoice. Owners buy products from Fitvario; different from ecommerce_cart_orders (a gym selling to its members).

owner_billing_history.evidence: owner_billing_views.py OwnerBillingHistoryView / TransactionDetail / Queue: invoices and payments for the owner's Fitvario subscription.

member_notification_center.evidence: InAppNotification; notifications/ routes (list, unread-count, mark-all-read) and notification-preferences/reminder-preferences for members.

owner_push_broadcast.evidence: owner/send-push route: owner sends a push message to members. Uses notification wallet credits.

auto_absent_marking.evidence: management command mark_absent_attendance. Cron schedule not verified.

member_birthdays_list.evidence: members/birthdays route (owner list). The automatic birthday message is the separate whatsapp_birthday_messages flag.

daily_owner_summary.evidence: management command notify_daily_summary. Per the 25 Sep audit it was NOT scheduled; do not claim it.

account_deletion.evidence: owner/delete-account and member/account routes. The /delete-account page and Play Data safety rely on this being true.

member_data_import.evidence: A one-off data-import folder exists beside the repos (used for the RAW FITNESS migration), but there is no self-serve import feature. The site says 'we help you bring in your existing member list'; that is a service claim awaiting owner confirmation.

single_app_role_login.evidence: Owner: one app, the Fitvario app on Google Play (com.fitvario.sumigyan), with role-based login for owners, staff and members.
